scripts.build:render: npm install && rm -rf dist && cd ../frontend/ && npm install && npm run build && cp -r dist ../backend
scripts.build: powershell -NoProfile -Command "npm.cmd install; if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }; Set-Location ../frontend; npm.cmd install; npm.cmd run build; Copy-Item dist ../backend -Recurse -Force; Set-Location ../backend"
